en.title: WealthFolio
en.description: Production-grade personal wealth intelligence platform built with Next.js, Supabase, and AI-assisted portfolio workflows for tracking holdings, cash flow, performance, fees, and investment insights in one dashboard.

en.title: Trump's Social Media & Bitcoin Analysis
en.description: LLM-powered analysis studying the causal relationship between Trump's social media posts and Bitcoin returns during the 2024 U.S. Presidential Election.

en.title: Tourism, GRDP & Unemployment in Indonesia
en.description: Spatial panel data analysis examining how foreign and domestic tourism affect regional economic performance and unemployment across 34 Indonesian provinces (2018–2020).
highlights: Foreign tourism significantly increases GRDP and reduces unemployment
Domestic tourism shows limited economic impact
Strong spatial clustering but weak spillover effects

en.title: Exploring the Relationship Between Proxies of Social Capital Loss and Suicide In the United States (2000-2022)
en.description: Investigated the relationship between suicide rates and various proxies of 'Social Capital loss' in the United States from 2000 to 2022. The breakdown of society in the West, marked by rising rates of racism, hate speech, and discrimination, has been accompanied by an increase in suicide rates.
en.image: /images/Social Capital and Suicide in the United States.png

en.title: Analysis of Taiwan Presidential Elections (2000 vs. 2024)

zh.title: 觀光、GRDP 與失業：印尼省份分析
zh.description: 以空間面板資料探討 2018–2020 年外國與國內觀光對 34 個省份 GRDP 與失業率的影響。
highlights: 國際觀光顯著提高 GRDP 並降低失業率
國內觀光的經濟影響有限
存在空間聚落但外溢效果有限
tools: 空間繪圖與面板資料模型
